rules.title: XMP metadata must contain the PDF/UA identification schema
rules.detection: Catalog XMP metadata has no PDF/UA identification schema (pdfuaid:part absent)
rules.applies_when: only when a catalog /Metadata XMP packet exists (object MainXMPPackage)

rules.title: The pdfuaid:part value must be 1 for PDF/UA-1
rules.detection: pdfuaid:part is not 1
rules.applies_when: only when the PDF/UA identification schema is present

rules.title: The PDF/UA part property must use the pdfuaid prefix
rules.detection: the part property uses a namespace prefix other than 'pdfuaid'
rules.applies_when: only when the identification schema is present

rules.title: The PDF/UA amendment property (amd) must use the pdfuaid prefix
rules.detection: the amd property uses a prefix other than 'pdfuaid'
rules.applies_when: only when pdfuaid:amd is present

rules.title: The PDF/UA corrigendum property (corr) must use the pdfuaid prefix
rules.detection: the corr property uses a prefix other than 'pdfuaid'
rules.applies_when: only when pdfuaid:corr is present

rules.title: The file header must be %PDF-1.0 to %PDF-1.7 followed by an end-of-line marker
rules.detection: file header is not %PDF-1.0 .. %PDF-1.7
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: The catalog must declare the document as tagged (MarkInfo /Marked true)
rules.detection: catalog /MarkInfo missing or /Marked not true
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Artifacts must not be nested inside tagged content
rules.detection: an /Artifact marked-content sequence is nested inside tagged (MCID) content
rules.applies_when: every marked-content sequence in page/Form content

rules.title: Viewers must be told to show the document title (ViewerPreferences /DisplayDocTitle true)
rules.detection: catalog /ViewerPreferences missing or /DisplayDocTitle not true
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: The catalog must contain a structure tree root (StructTreeRoot)
rules.detection: catalog has no /StructTreeRoot
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Every structure element must have a parent entry (/P)

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a structure element dictionary lacks /P
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist)

rules.title: Tagged content must not be nested inside an artifact
rules.detection: tagged content (MCID) occurs inside an /Artifact sequence
rules.applies_when: every marked-content sequence

rules.title: All page content must be either tagged or marked as an artifact

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a content item (text/path/image) is neither inside an MCID sequence nor inside an Artifact
rules.applies_when: every simple content item on every page (also in untagged documents)

rules.title: MarkInfo /Suspects must not be true
rules.detection: /MarkInfo /Suspects is true
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Every non-standard structure type must be role-mapped, directly or through other custom types, to a standard type
rules.detection: a non-standard structure type has no RoleMap chain to a standard type
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); object SENonStandard = elements whose /S is not a standard type

rules.title: Role mapping must not be circular

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: the RoleMap chain of the element's type loops
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist)

rules.title: Standard structure types must not be remapped in the RoleMap
rules.detection: a standard structure type is itself remapped in RoleMap
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist)

rules.title: The catalog must reference an XMP metadata stream (/Type /Metadata, /Subtype /XML)
rules.detection: catalog has no /Metadata stream with /Type /Metadata /Subtype /XML
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: XMP metadata must contain a document title (dc:title)
rules.detection: catalog XMP has no dc:title
rules.applies_when: only when a catalog XMP packet exists

rules.title: Every optional content configuration (D and Configs entries) must have a Name

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: an optional content configuration dictionary (D or in Configs) has no non-empty /Name
rules.applies_when: only when /OCProperties exists

rules.title: Optional content configurations must not contain an AS entry
rules.detection: an optional content configuration dictionary has an /AS key
rules.applies_when: only when /OCProperties exists

rules.title: File specifications of embedded files must have non-empty F and UF entries
rules.detection: a file specification with /EF lacks non-empty /F or /UF
rules.applies_when: file specifications that embed a file

rules.title: Dynamic XFA forms are not permitted
rules.detection: the AcroForm XFA configuration requests dynamic rendering (veraPDF property dynamicRender == 'required', read from the XFA config packet - inferred)
rules.applies_when: only when an AcroForm exists

rules.title: Encryption must permit content extraction for accessibility (P entry present, bit 10 set)
rules.detection: encryption dictionary lacks /P or bit 10 (value 512, extraction for accessibility) is not set
rules.applies_when: only encrypted files

rules.title: Annotations other than Widget, PrinterMark and Link must be enclosed in an Annot element

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a visible annotation other than Widget/PrinterMark/Link is not the child (OBJR) of an Annot element
rules.applies_when: visible on-page annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: Visible annotations other than widgets need a Contents entry or an Alt on their structure element
rules.detection: a visible non-Widget annotation has no non-empty /Contents and its struct parent has no Alt
rules.applies_when: visible on-page non-Widget annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: Form fields need a TU entry or an Alt on the structure elements of all their widgets

standards.source: EqualDoX attribution: W3C WCAG 2 failure F68 (a user interface control without a programmatically determined name), PDF technique PDF12: under PDF/UA-1 a form field's name is its /TU, else the /Alt of its Form element; the rule fires only when both are missing or empty, so the field has no programmatic name

rules.detection: a visible widget's field has no non-empty /TU and the enclosing Form element has no /Alt
rules.applies_when: visible on-page widgets; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: TrapNet annotations are not permitted
rules.detection: a visible TrapNet annotation exists
rules.applies_when: TrapNet annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: Pages with annotations must use structure order as tab order (Tabs /S)
rules.detection: a page with annotations has no /Tabs /S
rules.applies_when: pages with /Annots

rules.title: Widget annotations must be enclosed in a Form element

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a visible widget's struct parent is not a Form element
rules.applies_when: visible widgets; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: A Form element without a Role attribute must have exactly one child: the reference to its widget
rules.detection: a Form element without a Role attribute (PrintField) does not have exactly one interactive child (OBJR to a widget)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Form elements

rules.title: Link annotations must be enclosed in a Link element

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a visible Link annotation's struct parent is not a Link element
rules.applies_when: visible Link annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: Link annotations need a Contents entry describing the link
rules.detection: a visible Link annotation has no non-empty /Contents
rules.applies_when: visible Link annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: Media clip data dictionaries need a CT (content type) entry
rules.detection: a media clip data dictionary lacks /CT
rules.applies_when: only media clips (Screen/Rendition)

rules.title: Media clip data dictionaries need an Alt entry
rules.detection: a media clip data dictionary lacks a correct /Alt (multi-language text array)
rules.applies_when: only media clips

rules.title: PrinterMark annotations must be treated as artifacts and kept out of the structure tree
rules.detection: a visible PrinterMark annotation is referenced from the structure tree
rules.applies_when: visible PrinterMark annotations; annotations whose /Rect lies outside the CropBox or whose F has the Hidden bit (2) are exempt

rules.title: TR elements may only have TH and TD children
rules.detection: a TR element has a standard-type kid other than ['TH', 'TD']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TR

rules.title: A Table may have at most one THead
rules.detection: a Table element has more than 1 THead kid(s)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: A Table may have at most one TFoot
rules.detection: a Table element has more than 1 TFoot kid(s)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: A Table with a TFoot must also have at least one TBody
rules.detection: a Table element has a TFoot kid but no TBody kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: A Table with a THead must also have at least one TBody
rules.detection: a Table element has a THead kid but no TBody kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: Table cells must not overlap other cells
rules.detection: a table cell overlaps another cell (via RowSpan/ColSpan)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TH/TD

rules.title: A Table's Caption must be its first or last child
rules.detection: a Table element has a Caption kid that is neither its first nor its last kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: LI elements must be placed inside an L
rules.detection: a LI element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['L']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is LI

rules.title: LBody elements must be placed inside an LI
rules.detection: a LBody element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['LI']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is LBody

rules.title: L elements may only have L, LI and Caption children
rules.detection: a L element has a standard-type kid other than ['L', 'LI', 'Caption']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is L

rules.title: The language of outline (bookmark) entries must be determinable
rules.detection: outline items exist and the catalog has no /Lang (variable gContainsCatalogLang false)
rules.applies_when: every outline item; masked entirely by a catalog /Lang

rules.title: LI elements may only have Lbl and LBody children
rules.detection: a LI element has a standard-type kid other than ['Lbl', 'LBody']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is LI

rules.title: The language of ActualText must be determinable
rules.detection: element has /ActualText but neither its own /Lang, an ancestor /Lang nor a catalog /Lang
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); only elements with ActualText

rules.title: The language of Alt text must be determinable
rules.detection: element has /Alt but no own/ancestor/catalog /Lang
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); only elements with Alt

rules.title: The language of expansion text (E) must be determinable
rules.detection: element has /E but no own/ancestor/catalog /Lang
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); only elements with E

rules.title: The language of annotation Contents must be determinable
rules.detection: annotation has /Contents, veraPDF finds no Lang for it (property containsLang false; source of that Lang not verified) and the catalog has no /Lang
rules.applies_when: annotations with Contents

rules.title: The language of form field descriptions (TU) must be determinable

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: form field has /TU but no Lang and no catalog /Lang
rules.applies_when: form fields with TU

rules.title: TOCI elements must be placed inside a TOC
rules.detection: a TOCI element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['TOC']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TOCI

rules.title: TOC elements may only have TOC, TOCI and Caption children
rules.detection: a TOC element has a standard-type kid other than ['TOC', 'TOCI', 'Caption']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TOC

rules.title: A TOC's Caption must be its first child
rules.detection: a TOC element has a Caption kid that is not its first kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TOC

rules.title: Lang values must be well-formed language tags
rules.detection: a /Lang value (catalog, struct elem, property list) is not a syntactically valid BCP-47-like tag ([A-Za-z]{1,8}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*)
rules.applies_when: every Lang entry present (empty string fails)

rules.title: Table elements may only have TR, THead, TBody, TFoot and Caption children
rules.detection: a Table element has a standard-type kid other than ['TR', 'THead', 'TBody', 'TFoot', 'Caption']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: The language of ActualText on Span marked content must be determinable
rules.detection: a /Span marked-content sequence has ActualText but no Lang (own, inherited) and no catalog Lang
rules.applies_when: only Span marked content with ActualText

rules.title: The language of Alt text on Span marked content must be determinable
rules.detection: a /Span marked-content sequence has Alt but no Lang
rules.applies_when: only Span MC with Alt

rules.title: The language of expansion text (E) on Span marked content must be determinable
rules.detection: a /Span marked-content sequence has E but no Lang
rules.applies_when: only Span MC with E

rules.title: The language of the document metadata must be determinable
rules.detection: XMP rdf:Alt arrays use x-default but the catalog has no /Lang (deferred: evaluated after the whole document)
rules.applies_when: XMP language alternatives (e.g. dc:title x-default)

rules.title: The language of text in page content must be determinable
rules.detection: text content item has no Lang (marked-content/struct) and the catalog has no /Lang
rules.applies_when: every text item; masked entirely by a catalog /Lang

rules.title: THead elements may only have TR children
rules.detection: a THead element has a standard-type kid other than ['TR']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is THead

rules.title: TBody elements may only have TR children
rules.detection: a TBody element has a standard-type kid other than ['TR']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TBody

rules.title: TFoot elements may only have TR children
rules.detection: a TFoot element has a standard-type kid other than ['TR']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TFoot

rules.title: A Table may have at most one Caption
rules.detection: a Table element has more than 1 Caption kid(s)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Table

rules.title: TR elements must be placed inside a Table, THead, TBody or TFoot
rules.detection: a TR element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['Table', 'THead', 'TBody', 'TFoot']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TR

rules.title: An L's Caption must be its first child
rules.detection: a L element has a Caption kid that is not its first kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is L

rules.title: Every table column must span the same number of rows (row spans included)
rules.detection: a column of the table has a different number of rows (RowSpan taken into account)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table elements

rules.title: Every table row must span the same number of columns (column spans included)
rules.detection: a row has a different number of columns than the others and veraPDF could not attribute it to a wrong ColSpan (wrongColumnSpan null)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table elements

rules.title: Column spans must not make a table row wider or narrower than the others
rules.detection: a row has a different number of columns and a wrong ColSpan value is identified
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table elements

rules.title: THead elements must be placed inside a Table
rules.detection: a THead element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['Table']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is THead

rules.title: TBody elements must be placed inside a Table
rules.detection: a TBody element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['Table']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TBody

rules.title: TFoot elements must be placed inside a Table
rules.detection: a TFoot element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['Table']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TFoot

rules.title: TH elements must be placed inside a TR
rules.detection: a TH element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['TR']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TH

rules.title: TD elements must be placed inside a TR
rules.detection: a TD element's nearest non-pass-through standard parent is not one of ['TR']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is TD

rules.title: Reference XObjects are not permitted
rules.detection: a Form XObject has /Ref (reference XObject)
rules.applies_when: every Form XObject

rules.title: Tagged content of a Form XObject must not be shared by several structure parents
rules.detection: a Form XObject containing marked content is used by several structure parents (isUniqueSemanticParent false)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Form XObjects painted with MCIDs

rules.title: A CIDFont's CIDSystemInfo must match its non-Identity CMap (same Registry and Ordering, Supplement not higher)
rules.detection: Type 0 font with a non-Identity CMap whose Registry/Ordering differ from the CIDFont's CIDSystemInfo or whose Supplement is larger
rules.applies_when: Type 0 fonts used in content

rules.title: Embedded CIDFontType2 fonts need a CIDToGIDMap
rules.detection: an embedded CIDFontType2 has no /CIDToGIDMap
rules.applies_when: embedded Type 2 CIDFonts

rules.title: CMaps other than the predefined ones must be embedded

sources.severity_source: key prefix (CheckFail/CheckWarn); replaced by the observed icon where a fixture triggered it

rules.detection: a CMap that is not one of the predefined Table 118 names is not embedded
rules.applies_when: Type 0 fonts

rules.title: The WMode of an embedded CMap must match its CMap dictionary
rules.detection: embedded CMap's /WMode differs from the WMode in the CMap program
rules.applies_when: embedded CMap streams

rules.title: An embedded CMap may only use predefined CMaps (usecmap)
rules.detection: an embedded CMap uses (usecmap) a CMap not in Table 118
rules.applies_when: embedded CMap streams with usecmap

rules.title: Fonts used for rendering must be embedded
rules.detection: a non-Type3/non-Type0 font used for rendering (Tr != 3) has no font program
rules.applies_when: fonts used by text-showing operators

rules.title: Embedded fonts must contain every glyph used for rendering
rules.detection: an embedded font lacks a glyph referenced for rendering
rules.applies_when: glyphs of embedded fonts not in Tr 3

rules.title: A Type 1 CharSet must list every glyph of the embedded font program
rules.detection: subset Type 1 font (ABCDEF+ prefix) with /CharSet that does not list every glyph in the program
rules.applies_when: embedded subset Type 1 fonts with CharSet

rules.title: A CIDSet must identify every CID of the embedded font program
rules.detection: subset CID font with /CIDSet that does not identify all CIDs in the program
rules.applies_when: embedded subset CIDFonts with CIDSet

rules.title: Glyph widths in the font dictionary must agree with the embedded font program
rules.detection: glyph width in /Widths (or W) differs by more than 1 unit from the embedded program's advance
rules.applies_when: glyphs of embedded fonts not in Tr 3

rules.title: Non-symbolic TrueType programs need a cmap subtable usable for non-symbolic glyph lookup
rules.detection: non-symbolic TrueType program has no usable non-symbolic cmap subtable
rules.applies_when: non-symbolic TrueType fonts used for rendering

rules.title: Non-symbolic TrueType fonts must use MacRoman or WinAnsi encoding, with Differences limited to Adobe Glyph List names
rules.detection: non-symbolic TrueType font's Encoding is not MacRoman/WinAnsi or its Differences use non-AGL names
rules.applies_when: non-symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Symbolic TrueType fonts must not have an Encoding entry
rules.detection: symbolic TrueType font dictionary has an /Encoding entry
rules.applies_when: symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Symbolic TrueType programs need a (3,0) cmap subtable unless they have exactly one subtable
rules.detection: symbolic TrueType program has more than one cmap subtable and no (3,0)
rules.applies_when: symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Every character code used must map to Unicode
rules.detection: a used glyph has no Unicode mapping (no ToUnicode entry and no standard encoding route)
rules.applies_when: every glyph shown (also Tr 3)

rules.title: ToUnicode must not map codes to U+0000, U+FEFF or U+FFFE
rules.detection: ToUnicode maps a used code to U+0000, U+FEFF or U+FFFE
rules.applies_when: glyphs with ToUnicode

rules.title: Text must not reference the .notdef glyph
rules.detection: a text-showing operator references the .notdef glyph
rules.applies_when: every glyph shown (any rendering mode)

rules.title: Figure elements need alternative text (Alt) or replacement text (ActualText)
rules.detection: Figure has no non-empty /Alt and no /ActualText
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Figure (after role mapping)

rules.title: Numbered headings must start at H1 and must not skip levels
rules.detection: a numbered heading Hn skips a level (e.g. H1 then H3) or the first heading is not H1 (veraPDF hasCorrectNestingLevel)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); only weakly structured documents using H1..Hn

rules.title: A structure element may have at most one H child
rules.detection: a * element has more than 1 H kid(s)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated on every structure element

rules.title: A document using H elements must not also use numbered headings (H1-H6)
rules.detection: the document uses H and also Hn (deferred, variable usesHn)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); H elements, evaluated after the whole tree

rules.title: A document using numbered headings (H1-H6) must not also use H elements
rules.detection: the document uses Hn and also H (deferred, variable usesH)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Hn elements

rules.title: Table data cells must be associated with header cells (Headers/IDs or TH Scope)
rules.detection: a TD has no connected header (no Headers/IDs, no Scope-derivable TH) and no unknown header ids
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TD in tables that have TH

rules.title: Headers attributes of table cells must refer to existing header IDs
rules.detection: a TD has no connected header and its /Headers names IDs that do not exist
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TD

rules.title: Formula elements need alternative text (Alt) or replacement text (ActualText)
rules.detection: Formula has no non-empty /Alt and no /ActualText
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Formula

rules.title: Note elements need a non-empty ID
rules.detection: Note element has no /ID or an empty one
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Note

rules.title: Note IDs must be unique
rules.detection: two Note elements share the same /ID
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Note

rules.title: XMP metadata must contain the PDF/UA identification schema
rules.detection: catalog XMP has no PDF/UA identification schema
rules.applies_when: only when a catalog XMP packet exists

rules.title: The pdfuaid:part value must be 2 for PDF/UA-2
rules.detection: pdfuaid:part is not 2
rules.applies_when: only when the identification schema is present

rules.title: The PDF/UA part property must use the pdfuaid prefix
rules.detection: part property prefix is not 'pdfuaid'
rules.applies_when: only when the identification schema is present

rules.title: The PDF/UA revision property (rev) must use the pdfuaid prefix
rules.detection: rev property prefix is not 'pdfuaid'
rules.applies_when: only when pdfuaid:rev present

rules.title: The pdfuaid:rev value must be 2024
rules.detection: pdfuaid:rev is not "2024" (also fails when absent)
rules.applies_when: only when the identification schema is present

rules.title: The catalog must declare the document as tagged (MarkInfo /Marked true)
rules.detection: catalog /MarkInfo missing or /Marked not true
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Widget annotations that are not artifacts must be enclosed in a Form element
rules.detection: a field widget's struct parent is not Form (non-artifact, tagged)
rules.applies_when: field widgets with a struct parent

rules.title: A Form element may enclose at most one widget annotation
rules.detection: a Form element contains more than one widget annotation
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Form

rules.title: XFA forms are not permitted
rules.detection: AcroForm contains /XFA
rules.applies_when: only when an AcroForm exists

rules.title: Widgets without a label (Lbl) need a Contents entry
rules.detection: a tagged field widget has no Lbl in its Form context and no /Contents
rules.applies_when: tagged non-artifact field widgets

rules.title: Widgets with additional actions (AA) need a Contents entry
rules.detection: a tagged field widget with /AA has no /Contents
rules.applies_when: tagged widgets with AA

rules.title: Text fields with a rich-text value (RV) also need a plain value (V) with the same text
rules.detection: text field has RV but V absent or not textually equal
rules.applies_when: text fields with RV

rules.title: Graphics in a signature appearance need alternative text
rules.detection: graphic content in a signature appearance has no Alt
rules.applies_when: graphic content items of signature widgets

rules.title: XMP metadata must contain a document title (dc:title)
rules.detection: XMP has no dc:title
rules.applies_when: only when XMP exists

rules.title: The catalog must reference an XMP metadata stream (/Type /Metadata, /Subtype /XML)
rules.detection: catalog has no XMP metadata stream
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Viewers must be told to show the document title (ViewerPreferences /DisplayDocTitle true)
rules.detection: ViewerPreferences missing or DisplayDocTitle not true
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Embedded files in the EmbeddedFiles name tree need a description (Desc)
rules.detection: a file specification in the EmbeddedFiles name tree has no /Desc
rules.applies_when: file specifications in /Names /EmbeddedFiles

rules.title: The catalog must contain a structure tree root (StructTreeRoot)
rules.detection: catalog has no /StructTreeRoot
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Every structure element must have a parent entry (/P)
rules.detection: a structure element lacks /P
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist)

rules.title: All page content must be either tagged as real content or marked as an artifact
rules.detection: a content item is neither tagged real content nor inside an Artifact
rules.applies_when: every simple content item on every page

rules.title: Every structure type must belong, or be role-mapped, to the PDF 1.7, PDF 2.0 or MathML namespace
rules.detection: an element's type is in no standard namespace (PDF 1.7, PDF 2.0, MathML) after role mapping (RoleMap / RoleMapNS)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); SENonStandard

rules.title: Role mapping must not be circular
rules.detection: role mapping is circular
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist)

rules.title: Structure types must not be role-mapped to other types of the same explicit namespace
rules.detection: within one explicit namespace a type is role mapped to another type of the same namespace
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); namespaced elements

rules.title: Role mapping must not remap a standard structure type
rules.detection: a non-standard element's mapping remaps a standard type (remappedStandardType)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); SENonStandard

rules.title: The H structure type is not permitted
rules.detection: an element of standard type H exists (test is constant false: any H fails)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); H

rules.title: Note elements are not permitted unless role-mapped into the PDF 2.0 namespace
rules.detection: an element of standard type Note exists (constant false)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Note

rules.title: Every element referring to an FENote must be listed in that FENote's Ref entry
rules.detection: FENote referenced content has orphan references (deferred: needs whole tree)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); FENote

rules.title: Every element listed in an FENote's Ref entry must refer back to that FENote
rules.detection: FENote has ghost references (deferred)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); FENote

rules.title: The NoteType of an FENote must be Footnote, Endnote or None
rules.detection: FENote NoteType attribute is not Footnote/Endnote/None (an absent NoteType presumably yields null and fails - inferred)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); FENote

rules.title: The structure tree root must have a single Document child and nothing else
rules.detection: a StructTreeRoot element's kid sequence is not one of ['Document']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated on the structure tree root

rules.title: The root Document element must be in the PDF 2.0 namespace
rules.detection: the single Document kid is not in the PDF 2.0 namespace http://iso.org/pdf2/ssn
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); only when the root has exactly one Document kid

rules.title: Link annotations must be enclosed in a Link or Reference element
rules.detection: a tagged, non-artifact Link annotation's struct parent is neither Link nor Reference
rules.applies_when: Link annotations with a struct parent (untagged ones are not checked)

rules.title: Link annotations with different targets must not share a Link or Reference element
rules.detection: Link annotations with different targets are in the same Link/Reference element
rules.applies_when: Link annotations

rules.title: Ruby children must be RB, RT or RB, RP, RT, RP
rules.detection: a Ruby element's kid sequence is not one of ['RB&RT', 'RB&RP&RT&RP']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Ruby

rules.title: Warichu children must be WP, WT, WP
rules.detection: a Warichu element's kid sequence is not one of ['WP&WT&WP']
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is Warichu

rules.title: Lists containing Lbl elements must set ListNumbering to a value other than None
rules.detection: an L containing Lbl elements has ListNumbering None (absent ListNumbering is presumably treated as the default None - inferred)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); L elements containing Lbl

rules.title: Content of an LI outside an Lbl must be enclosed in an LBody
rules.detection: a LI element contains content items (MCID/MCR/OBJR) directly or through pass-through kids
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated for every structure element whose standard type is LI

rules.title: Table cells must not overlap other cells
rules.detection: a cell overlaps another cell
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TH/TD

rules.title: Every table column must span the same number of rows, also within each THead, TBody and TFoot
rules.detection: a column has a wrong number of rows (RowSpan)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table

rules.title: Every table row must span the same number of columns (column spans included)
rules.detection: a row has a different number of columns, no wrong ColSpan identified
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table

rules.title: Column spans must not make a table row wider or narrower than the others
rules.detection: a row has a different number of columns due to a wrong ColSpan
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Table

rules.title: Table data cells must be associated with their header cells
rules.detection: TD without connected header and without unknown header ids (in tables with TH)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TD

rules.title: Headers attributes of table cells must refer to existing header IDs
rules.detection: TD whose /Headers refer to unknown IDs
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TD

rules.title: A Caption must be the first or last child of its parent
rules.detection: a * element has a Caption kid that is neither its first nor its last kid
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot; evaluated on every structure element

rules.title: Figure elements need alternative text (Alt) or replacement text (ActualText)
rules.detection: Figure has neither /Alt nor /ActualText (empty Alt passes in UA-2, unlike UA-1)
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); Figure

rules.title: MathML math elements must be placed inside a Formula
rules.detection: a MathML-namespace element is not inside Formula or another MathML element
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); MathML namespace elements

rules.title: Each TOCI must identify its target with a Ref entry (on itself or a descendant)
rules.detection: a TOCI has no /Ref (directly or in a descendant) identifying its target
rules.applies_when: only when the document has a StructTreeRoot (structure elements exist); TOCI

rules.title: Real content mapped to Private Use Area code points needs ActualText or Alt
rules.detection: real-content glyph maps to Unicode PUA and no ActualText/Alt covers it
rules.applies_when: every real-content glyph

rules.title: ActualText must not contain Private Use Area code points
rules.detection: an ActualText string contains PUA code points
rules.applies_when: every ActualText

rules.title: Alt text must not contain Private Use Area code points
rules.detection: an Alt string contains PUA code points
rules.applies_when: every Alt

rules.title: The catalog must state the default document language in a non-empty Lang entry
rules.detection: catalog has no (non-empty) /Lang
rules.applies_when: always (one document-level object)

rules.title: Lang values must be well-formed language tags
rules.detection: a Lang value is not a valid language tag
rules.applies_when: every Lang entry

rules.title: A CIDFont's CIDSystemInfo must match its non-Identity CMap (same Registry and Ordering, Supplement not higher)
rules.applies_when: Type 0 fonts

rules.title: Embedded CIDFontType2 fonts need a CIDToGIDMap
rules.detection: embedded CIDFontType2 without CIDToGIDMap
rules.applies_when: embedded Type 2 CIDFonts

rules.title: CMaps other than the predefined ones must be embedded
rules.detection: non-predefined CMap not embedded
rules.applies_when: Type 0 fonts

rules.title: The WMode of an embedded CMap must match its CMap dictionary
rules.detection: CMap WMode mismatch
rules.applies_when: embedded CMaps

rules.title: An embedded CMap may only use predefined CMaps (usecmap)
rules.detection: CMap references a non-predefined CMap
rules.applies_when: embedded CMaps

rules.title: Fonts used for rendering must be embedded
rules.detection: font used for rendering not embedded
rules.applies_when: fonts used by text

rules.title: Embedded fonts must contain every glyph used for rendering
rules.detection: embedded font lacks a referenced glyph
rules.applies_when: glyphs not in Tr 3

rules.title: Glyph widths in the font dictionary must agree with the embedded font program
rules.detection: dictionary width differs from program width by > 1
rules.applies_when: glyphs not in Tr 3

rules.title: Non-symbolic TrueType programs need a (3,1) or (1,0) cmap subtable
rules.detection: non-symbolic TrueType program has neither (3,1) nor (1,0) cmap
rules.applies_when: non-symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Non-symbolic TrueType fonts must use MacRoman or WinAnsi encoding, with Differences limited to Adobe Glyph List names
rules.detection: non-symbolic TrueType Encoding not MacRoman/WinAnsi or bad Differences
rules.applies_when: non-symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Symbolic TrueType fonts must not have an Encoding entry
rules.detection: symbolic TrueType font has an Encoding
rules.applies_when: symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Symbolic TrueType programs need a (3,0) or (1,0) cmap subtable
rules.detection: symbolic TrueType program has neither (3,0) nor (1,0) cmap
rules.applies_when: symbolic TrueType fonts

rules.title: Every character code used must map to Unicode
rules.detection: glyph without Unicode mapping
rules.applies_when: every glyph

rules.title: ToUnicode must not map codes to U+0000, U+FEFF or U+FFFE
rules.detection: ToUnicode maps to U+0000/FEFF/FFFE
rules.applies_when: glyphs with ToUnicode

rules.title: Text must not reference the .notdef glyph
rules.detection: .notdef glyph referenced
rules.applies_when: every glyph

rules.title: Human-readable text strings must not contain Private Use Area code points
rules.detection: a human-readable text string (e.g. outline title, /TU, /Contents, /Alt) contains PUA code points
rules.applies_when: text strings (CosTextString)

rules.title: Optional content configurations need a non-empty Name
rules.detection: an OC configuration dictionary has no non-empty /Name (variable gContainsConfigs: only when /Configs exists)
rules.applies_when: only when /OCProperties /Configs is present

rules.title: Optional content configurations must not contain an AS entry
rules.detection: an OC configuration dictionary has /AS
rules.applies_when: only when /OCProperties exists

rules.title: Destinations inside the document must be structure destinations
rules.detection: an intra-document destination (outline Dest, OpenAction, Link Dest) is not a structure destination (/SD)
rules.applies_when: destinations whose target is in this document

rules.title: GoTo actions must use a structure destination (SD)
rules.detection: a GoTo action has no structure destination (SD)
rules.applies_when: GoTo actions

rules.title: Annotations with the Invisible flag must be artifacts
rules.detection: a tagged annotation with the Invisible flag (1) is not an artifact
rules.applies_when: annotations with a struct parent

rules.title: Annotations with NoView set and ToggleNoView unset must be artifacts
rules.detection: a tagged annotation with NoView (32) but without ToggleNoView (256) is not an artifact
rules.applies_when: annotations with a struct parent

rules.title: Markup annotations must be enclosed in an Annot element
rules.detection: a tagged non-artifact markup annotation's struct parent is not Annot
rules.applies_when: markup annotations with a struct parent

rules.title: RC and Contents of a markup annotation must carry the same text
rules.detection: markup annotation has RC and Contents that are not equal (veraPDF compares the plain-text forms)
rules.applies_when: markup annotations with RC

rules.title: File specifications of file attachment annotations need an AFRelationship entry
rules.detection: file attachment annotation's file specification has no AFRelationship
rules.applies_when: FileAttachment annotations with FS

rules.title: Sound annotations are not permitted
rules.detection: a Sound annotation exists (constant false)
rules.applies_when: Sound annotations

rules.title: Movie annotations are not permitted
rules.detection: a Movie annotation exists (constant false)
rules.applies_when: Movie annotations

rules.title: Screen annotations need a Contents entry
rules.detection: Screen annotation has no Contents
rules.applies_when: Screen annotations

rules.title: Widgets with zero width and height must be artifacts
rules.detection: a tagged zero-width/zero-height widget is not an artifact (test: width != 0 || height != 0 passes, i.e. only 0x0 widgets fail)
rules.applies_when: widgets with a struct parent

rules.title: PrinterMark annotations must be artifacts
rules.detection: a PrinterMark annotation has a non-artifact struct parent
rules.applies_when: PrinterMark annotations

rules.title: TrapNet annotations are not permitted
rules.detection: a TrapNet annotation exists (constant false)
rules.applies_when: TrapNet annotations

rules.title: Watermark annotations used as real content must be enclosed in an Annot element
rules.detection: a tagged non-artifact Watermark annotation's parent is not Annot
rules.applies_when: Watermark annotations with a struct parent

rules.title: 3D annotations need a Contents entry as alternative description
rules.detection: 3D annotation has no Contents
rules.applies_when: 3D annotations

rules.title: RichMedia annotations need a Contents entry as alternative description
rules.detection: RichMedia annotation has no Contents
rules.applies_when: RichMedia annotations

rules.title: Stamp annotations need a Name or a Contents entry describing their intent
rules.detection: Stamp annotation has neither Name nor Contents
rules.applies_when: Stamp annotations

rules.title: Ink annotations need a Contents entry describing their intent
rules.detection: Ink annotation has no Contents
rules.applies_when: Ink annotations

rules.title: Popup annotations must not be part of the structure tree
rules.detection: a Popup annotation has a struct parent
rules.applies_when: Popup annotations

rules.title: Pages with annotations must define a tab order (Tabs A, W or S)
rules.detection: a page with annotations has no /Tabs or Tabs not in {A, W, S}
rules.applies_when: pages with /Annots

rules.title: An annotation's Contents must equal the Alt of its enclosing structure element when both exist
rules.detection: annotation /Contents and its enclosing struct element's /Alt are both present and differ
rules.applies_when: annotations with Contents whose parent has Alt

rules.title: Text possibly set apart by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1, manual review)

sources.condition_text: Text possibly set apart by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1, manual review)

rules.detection: text on a line in the same font and size as the adjacent text but another colour, the two less than 3:1 apart, with no underline and no link border (for links WCAG failure F73)
rules.applies_when: no line with text in two colours

rules.title: Graphical object or form field possibly below the WCAG 1.4.11 minimum of 3:1 (manual review)

sources.condition_text: Graphical object or form field possibly below the WCAG 1.4.11 minimum of 3:1 (manual review)

rules.detection: painted parts (fill or stroke) of tagged Figure content against a flat background (white or one opaque rectangle), one finding per Figure and page; form fields (text, choice, button; neither read-only nor hidden) whose /MK border or background has less than 3:1 against an empty or flat page area
rules.applies_when: no Figure graphics and no form fields

rules.title: Text contrast below the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum (exact measurement)

sources.condition_text: Text contrast below the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum (exact measurement)

rules.detection: rendered text whose colour (its own transparency composed) has less than 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text (18 pt, 14 pt bold), against a background known without rendering: the white page or one opaque rectangle painted before the text; text and background in DeviceGray or DeviceRGB, normal paint, inside its clip, not an artifact, not inside a Figure, size class certain
rules.applies_when: no rendered text

rules.title: Text contrast possibly below the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum (manual review)

sources.condition_text: Text contrast possibly below the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum (manual review)

rules.detection: the same measurement where the verdict needs a human: background from the rendering (images, gradients, overlapping paint), CMYK or spot colours, soft masks or blend modes, partial clipping, outlined text, artifacts (only where the background is flat), text inside a Figure (picture or logotype exception), large-text status uncertain, text in its background's colour
rules.applies_when: no rendered text

rules.title: WTPDF reuse conformance must be declared (pdfd:conformsTo http://pdfa.org/declarations/wtpdf#reuse1.0)
rules.detection: XMP has no pdfd:declarations entry conformsTo http://pdfa.org/declarations/wtpdf#reuse1.0
rules.applies_when: only when a catalog XMP packet exists

rules.title: WTPDF accessibility conformance must be declared (pdfd:conformsTo http://pdfa.org/declarations/wtpdf#accessibility1.0)
rules.detection: XMP has no pdfd:declarations entry conformsTo http://pdfa.org/declarations/wtpdf#accessibility1.0
rules.applies_when: only when a catalog XMP packet exists
